Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that creates an emulation environment using the seed-emulator library. The environment should include three types of autonomous systems (AS): transit, stub, and utility. 

For the transit AS, create two internet exchanges with specific display names, three internal networks, and four routers linked in a linear structure. 

For the stub AS, create three different systems. The first two should have an internal network, a router, and two host nodes. The first host node should have additional software installed and a new account created. The third system should be created using a utility function and further customized.

Establish BGP peering by creating an Ebgp layer and setting up the transit AS as the internet service provider for all the stub ASes. Also, set up direct peering between two of the stub ASes.

Create a web service layer with two web service nodes and bind these virtual nodes to physical nodes. 

Add all the created layers to the emulator and save it to a component file. Render the emulator and change the display names for the nodes hosting the web services.

Finally, compile the emulator using Docker, specifying custom images from DockerHub and local sources. Generate Docker files and copy the base container image to the output folder.

```python
from seedemu import Emulator, Layer
from seedemu.layers import AutonomousSystem, Ebgp, WebService
from seedemu.services import WebServer

# Create the emulator
emu = Emulator()

# --- Transit AS ---
transit_asn = 65000
transit_as = AutonomousSystem(transit_asn)
transit_as.setDisplayName("Transit AS")

# Create two Internet Exchanges with specific display names
ix1 = transit_as.createInternetExchange("ix1")
ix1.setDisplayName("IX Alpha")
ix2 = transit_as.createInternetExchange("ix2")
ix2.setDisplayName("IX Beta")

# Create three internal networks
net1 = transit_as.createNetwork("net1")
net2 = transit_as.createNetwork("net2")
net3 = transit_as.createNetwork("net3")

# Create four routers linked in a linear structure
r1 = transit_as.createRouter("r1")
r2 = transit_as.createRouter("r2")
r3 = transit_as.createRouter("r3")
r4 = transit_as.createRouter("r4")

transit_as.setDisplayName("Transit AS")

# Link routers linearly: r1-net1-r2-net2-r3-net3-r4
transit_as.setLink(r1, net1)
transit_as.setLink(net1, r2)
transit_as.setLink(r2, net2)
transit_as.setLink(net2, r3)
transit_as.setLink(r3, net3)
transit_as.setLink(net3, r4)

# Connect routers to IXes
transit_as.joinInternetExchange(r1, ix1)
transit_as.joinInternetExchange(r4, ix2)

# --- Stub ASes ---
stub1_asn = 65001
stub2_asn = 65002
stub3_asn = 65003

# Stub 1
stub1 = AutonomousSystem(stub1_asn)
stub1.setDisplayName("Stub AS 1")
stub1_net = stub1.createNetwork("stub1-net")
stub1_router = stub1.createRouter("stub1-router")
stub1.setLink(stub1_router, stub1_net)
stub1_host1 = stub1.createHost("stub1-host1")
stub1_host2 = stub1.createHost("stub1-host2")
stub1.setLink(stub1_host1, stub1_net)
stub1.setLink(stub1_host2, stub1_net)
# Install additional software and create a new account on stub1-host1
stub1_host1.addSoftware("nginx")
stub1_host1.createAccount("webadmin", "webadminpw")

# Stub 2
stub2 = AutonomousSystem(stub2_asn)
stub2.setDisplayName("Stub AS 2")
stub2_net = stub2.createNetwork("stub2-net")
stub2_router = stub2.createRouter("stub2-router")
stub2.setLink(stub2_router, stub2_net)
stub2_host1 = stub2.createHost("stub2-host1")
stub2_host2 = stub2.createHost("stub2-host2")
stub2.setLink(stub2_host1, stub2_net)
stub2.setLink(stub2_host2, stub2_net)

# Stub 3 using a utility function and further customized
stub3 = AutonomousSystem.makeStubAs(stub3_asn, numHosts=1)
stub3.setDisplayName("Stub AS 3")
stub3_host = stub3.getHosts()[0]
stub3_host.addSoftware("curl")
stub3_host.createAccount("tester", "testpw")

# --- Add AS layers to emulator ---
emu.addLayer(transit_as)
emu.addLayer(stub1)
emu.addLayer(stub2)
emu.addLayer(stub3)

# --- BGP Peering ---
ebgp = Ebgp()
# Set transit AS as ISP for all stub ASes
ebgp.addCustomerProvider(stub1_asn, transit_asn)
ebgp.addCustomerProvider(stub2_asn, transit_asn)
ebgp.addCustomerProvider(stub3_asn, transit_asn)
# Direct peering between stub1 and stub2
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(stub1_asn, stub2_asn)
emu.addLayer(ebgp)

# --- Web Service Layer ---
web_layer = WebService()
# Create two web service nodes
ws1 = web_layer.createWebService("web1")
ws2 = web_layer.createWebService("web2")
# Bind virtual nodes to physical nodes
web_layer.bind(ws1, stub1_host1)
web_layer.bind(ws2, stub2_host1)
emu.addLayer(web_layer)

# --- Save to component file ---
emu.save("emulation.bin")

# --- Render the emulator and change display names for web service hosts ---
emu.render()
stub1_host1.setDisplayName("Web Server Alpha")
stub2_host1.setDisplayName("Web Server Beta")

# --- Compile using Docker with custom images ---
emu.compile(
    Docker(
        imageOverrides={
            "router": "customorg/custom-router:latest",
            "host": "./local-images/custom-host-image.tar"
        }
    )
)

# --- Generate Docker files and copy base container image to output folder ---
emu.gen_emulation_files()
emu.copyFile("./local-images/custom-host-image.tar", "./output/custom-host-image.tar")
```
